{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Easy Dinners|Easy Dinners]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]]

A simple salty dish with onions and pasta.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]] or [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic|Garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* [[Cookbook:Onions|Onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] pasta until tender.
# Oil your pan over medium heat.
# Add onions and garlic to pan. Cook until transparent and browning.
# Add pasta to pan along with more oil and some salt.
# Cook pasta, stirring regularly, until it begins to brown.
# Add extra salt as needed.
# Let it cool and serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* This dish is supposed to be salty and oily. Feel free to go a little crazy.

== Warnings ==

* You must stir regularly, otherwise some pasta will burn and other pasta won't brown
